concerns.location: plan.md: Phase 2.2 / Constitution Check row VI
concerns.text: Plan claims 'FFT (`ifft(fft(w)·conj(fft(w)))`), `int64` accumulation' — FFT-based convolution is inherently float64; you cannot have both. Constitution VI requires exact integer arithmetic for autocorrelation sums. Either state that sums are recomputed exactly in int64 for verification (e.g., spot-check vs direct summation) or acknowledge the FFT float path with an integer cross-validation step. As written the two statements contradict each other.

concerns.location: plan.md: Phase 1.1 / data-model.md §1 vs spec.md FR-001
concerns.text: FR-001 mandates 'ternary array … using 2-bit encoding'; plan and data-model specify `int8` with no note acknowledging or justifying the deviation. Cross-doc disagreement — either adopt packed 2-bit storage or add an explicit documented deviation (int8 at 10 MB is well within SC-004, but the mismatch should be stated).

SC-005 requires uniformity of p-values 'simulated on random data'; Phase 5.1 runs KS on the raw p-values from the real μ windows. These test different things (real-data p-values need not be uniform if the null is false). Align Phase 5 with SC-005 (simulate under the null) or run both and label them.

The 4 h guard silently narrows FR-007's sensitivity analysis to L ∈ {10³, 10⁴}. Logging mitigates the silent-fallback concern (Constitution II), but the plan should state explicitly that this is a documented, logged degradation of an FR-mandated scope and that the full-scope run remains the deliverable when runtime permits.
